description: Golden dataset for Astra Triage evaluation. Each case has an expected category and an expected routing outcome ('draft' or 'escalate'). Use this to measure classification accuracy and end-to-end routing correctness — see stage4/evaluation.py for the scoring TODOs.

cases.subject: Charged twice this month
cases.body: I was charged twice for my subscription this month, please refund the extra charge.

cases.subject: Invoice question
cases.body: Can you explain the credit and payment listed on my latest receipt?

cases.subject: App keeps crashing
cases.body: The app crashes on startup every time since the last update, giving an error message.

cases.subject: Getting 500 error
cases.body: Checkout fails with a 500 internal server error, it's been timing out for an hour.

cases.subject: Locked out
cases.body: My account got locked after too many failed login attempts and I can't reset my password.

cases.subject: 2FA issue
cases.body: I lost my authenticator app and now I can't get past the 2fa verification step to log in.

cases.subject: Feature suggestion
cases.body: It would be nice if you could add a dark mode feature, please add this to the roadmap.

cases.subject: My account was hacked
cases.body: I think my account was hacked, there was unauthorized access and I suspect a phishing breach.

cases.subject: Possible fraud
cases.body: I noticed a security vulnerability that looks like it could be exploited, this seems urgent.
